using KernelInterface
using Atomix

function kernel!(out::Vector{Float32}, labels::Vector{Int32}, x::Vector{Float32}, n::Int32)
    for i in 1:n
        idx = KI.get_global_id().x
        if idx > n
            break
        end
        if labels[i] >= 1 && labels[i] <= length(out)
            @atomic out[labels[i]] = max(out[labels[i]], x[i]) order=:monotonic
        end
    end
end
